lblAircraft: The aircraft whose stores these are: the type picked on the Performance page.
lblAC: The aircraft whose stores these are: the type picked on the Performance page.
rbnLead: Shows and changes the lead's stores (#1). Each aircraft of the flight has its own; Copy to flight gives one aircraft's to all.
rbnWingman: Shows and changes the wingman's stores (#2). Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.
rbnElemLead: Shows and changes the element lead's stores (#3). Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.
rbnElemWingman: Shows and changes the element wingman's stores (#4). Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.
btnClear: Takes every store off every aircraft of the flight. Cancel puts them back.
btnOK: Hands the stores' weight, drag and fuel to the Performance page and the DataCard's take-off figures. With a mission open it asks first: BMS's own loadout is not changed.
btnCancel: Closes the window and puts the stores back as they were when it opened.
picLoadout: Your jet with its hardpoints, a card under each: tap a card to pick that station, − and + change the count, ✕ empty clears it.
lblAA: The stores on this aircraft by kind (air-to-air, air-to-ground, pods, fuel tanks) with their counts.
dgvLoadOut: Every store this jet can carry, as tiles: tap one to hang it. The chips above narrow the list; the foot says what the app's Arsenal knows of the last one tapped.
lblEmptyWeight: The jet's empty weight, lb, from Falcon BMS's aircraft data.
lblEmptyW: The jet's empty weight, lb, from Falcon BMS's aircraft data.
lblLoad: What the stores, pylons and racks on this aircraft weigh, lb.
lblLoadW: What the stores, pylons and racks on this aircraft weigh, lb.
lblFuelInt: Internal fuel, lb: the jet's full tanks, or what the save gives this aircraft.
lblFuelIntW: Internal fuel, lb: the jet's full tanks, or what the save gives this aircraft.
lblFuelExt: Fuel in the external tanks hung on this aircraft, lb.
lblFuelExtW: Fuel in the external tanks hung on this aircraft, lb.
lblFuelUsed: Always 0 here: fuel a save's flight has already burnt is taken off the Performance page's Block Fuel instead.
lblFuelUsedW: Always 0 here: fuel a save's flight has already burnt is taken off the Performance page's Block Fuel instead.
lblGross: Empty weight + stores + fuel, lb. Red above the maximum weight.
lblGrossW: Empty weight + stores + fuel, lb. Red above the maximum weight.
lblMax: The jet's maximum take-off weight, lb, from Falcon BMS's aircraft data.
lblMaxW: The jet's maximum take-off weight, lb, from Falcon BMS's aircraft data.
lblDrag: The drag index: 1 for the clean jet plus each store, pylon and rack, from BMS's data. The Performance page's climb and cruise figures use it.
lblDragVal: The drag index: 1 for the clean jet plus each store, pylon and rack, from BMS's data. The Performance page's climb and cruise figures use it.
